law.catch_line: Bank's right to refuse to enter into or disclose existence of control agreement
law.text: This title does not require a bank to enter into an agreement of the kind described in § 8.9A-104 (a) (2), even if its customer so requests or directs. A bank that has entered into such an agreement is not required to confirm the existence of the agreement to another person unless requested to do so by its customer.
